prompts.freeride-scene.jpg: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape editorial ski training photograph, 3:2 horizontal. Show one adult skilled freeride skier making a fluid medium-speed turn in fresh powder on a broad, ungroomed, gentle open Alpine slope. Clearly off piste: untracked soft snow, natural uneven surface, one graceful powder spray, distant forest and mountain backdrop. No groomed piste, lifts, park or jumps. Skier fully visible, two natural correctly proportioned skis and two poles, anatomically credible stance and equipment, helmet and goggles, muted blue/teal jacket with warm rust accent. Elegant natural winter light, realistic snow texture, documentary sports photography. Composition useful for a training catalogue, skier in central-right portion, medium-wide framing, no extreme action or cliffs, no text, no logos or watermark.
prompts.freestyle-scene.jpg: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: landscape editorial ski training photograph, 3:2 horizontal. One adult freestyle skier performing a simple small straight jump in a clearly identifiable beginner terrain park, just above a modest groomed snow kicker, both twin-tip skis parallel and naturally proportioned, two poles, no flips, no grabbing, credible anatomy and equipment. A low rail module and terrain park signage with no legible text appear in background, groomed snow and soft forest backdrop. Helmet and goggles, muted warm rust jacket with dark navy pants. Show the entire skier and both skis unobstructed, energetic but approachable for a ski seller training guide. Clean soft daylight, polished realistic sports editorial photography, no large mountain panorama, no text, logos, watermark or duplicated equipment.
prompts.freeride-deep-v756.jpg: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: refined horizontal editorial ski catalogue photograph, very wide landscape framing with generous room above the helmet and below the skis. Show a clearly authentic adult FREERIDER making one fluid turn in genuinely DEEP fresh powder, snow reaching above the knees and almost to mid-thigh, boots and most of the skis buried naturally under snow, with only the two broad upturned ski tips visible forward and a substantial soft plume of powder curling behind the hips. Clothing must look like modern freeride culture: loose oversized mustard/tan technical anorak, baggy dark navy snow pants, black helmet and large goggles, compact avalanche backpack with visible shoulder and chest straps. No tight fitted piste/racing clothing. Natural athletic relaxed freeride stance, credible anatomy, exactly two skis and two poles with powder baskets. Entire helmet, torso, legs and ski tips must be contained comfortably in the central 70 percent of the image height so they survive a wide catalogue crop. Off-piste open Alpine terrain, snow-laden sparse conifers, fresh untouched deep snow, soft clear daylight. No groomed piste, no lifts, no park, no jumps, no buildings, no cliffs, no text, logos or watermark. The key story is the unmistakably deep powder and baggy freerider equipment, not a fashionable portrait or racing pose.
